The `promotedHasEvidenceAndProvenance` function accesses `item.layer` directly. If `item` is null or undefined, this will throw a TypeError and crash the validation process. Using optional chaining (`item?.layer`) prevents this TypeError.

```suggestion
function promotedHasEvidenceAndProvenance(item) {
  const requiredFields = item?.layer === 'accepted'
    ? ACCEPTED_REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS
    : PROVISIONAL_REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS;
  return hasEvidenceBundle(item) && missingProvenanceFields(item, requiredFields).length === 0;
}
```

<summary>References</summary>

1. When filtering or mapping arrays of objects, use defensive guards (such as checking if the element is a valid object) to ignore nullish or malformed elements instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

In `validatePromotionGate`, the check on `layers.blockedQuarantined` does not use optional chaining or defensive guards. If `layers` is nullish, or if any element in `blockedQuarantined` is nullish, it will throw a TypeError. Adding defensive guards ensures robustness.

```suggestion
    blockedPromoted.length === 0 &&
      (Array.isArray(layers?.blockedQuarantined) ? layers.blockedQuarantined : []).every((item) => (
        item?.layer === 'blocked_quarantined' &&
        item?.promotion_allowed === false &&
        item?.accepted_edge === false
      ))
```

In `validatePromotionGate`, the check on `layers.accepted` and `layers.provisionalSafe` does not use optional chaining or defensive guards. If `layers` is nullish, or if any element in these arrays is nullish, it will throw a TypeError. Adding defensive guards ensures robustness.

```suggestion
    (Array.isArray(layers?.accepted) ? layers.accepted : []).every((item) => item?.layer === 'accepted' && item?.accepted_edge === true) &&
      (Array.isArray(layers?.provisionalSafe) ? layers.provisionalSafe : []).every((item) => (
        item?.layer === 'provisional_safe' &&
        item?.accepted_edge === false &&
        item?.runtime_consumption_allowed === false
      ))
```

In `validatePromotionGate`, the check on `allLayerEntries` does not use optional chaining. If any element in `allLayerEntries` is nullish, it will throw a TypeError. Adding optional chaining ensures robustness.

```suggestion
    allLayerEntries.every((item) => item?.layer !== 'review_required' || item?.promotion_allowed === false)
```
